title: 7 LAGUNAS DEL AUSANGATE
description: Epic trekking through the 7 Ausangate Lakes, a high mountain circuit with turquoise-colored lakes and imposing snow-capped peaks. The least traveled route in Peru.

itinerary.title: Cusco - Tinki - Upis
itinerary.description: We depart from Cusco to Tinki (4,000 m) where the trekking begins. We'll walk 4 hours to Upis, passing through high-altitude landscapes and Andean grasslands.

itinerary.title: Ausangate Lakes - Travisique
itinerary.description: The most epic day: we'll visit the 7 colored lakes (emerald green, turquoise, deep blue) with the Ausangate snow-capped peak as backdrop. Camp in Travisique.

itinerary.title: Qomercocha - Tinki - Cusco
itinerary.description: We descend through Qomercocha and other panoramic viewpoints to Tinki. Transfer back to Cusco in the afternoon.

recommendations: Good physical condition (altitude up to 5,000 m)
